Manually assign cell type labels to clusters

Source: R/pandora_annotation.R
PANDORA_assign_labels.Rd

Maps cluster IDs to user-defined cell type labels using a named character vector, storing the result as a new colData column. Clusters without a matching entry in labels receive NA.

Usage

PANDORA_assign_labels(
  sce,
  labels,
  cluster_col = "cluster",
  label_col,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment.

labels

Named character vector. Names are cluster IDs (must match levels in cluster_col); values are cell type labels. Example: c("0" = "T cell", "1" = "B cell", "2" = "Myeloid").

cluster_col

Character. colData column containing cluster IDs. Default "cluster".

label_col

Character. Name of the new colData column to create. Must be supplied explicitly; no default to prevent accidental overwrites.

verbose

Logical. Print a summary. Default TRUE.

Value

SCE with colData(sce)[[label_col]] populated.
